name: alchemist-ai-root
description: Alchemist AI — Book-grounded RAG application for Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist

scripts.test:embedding: node -e "const cp = require('node:child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'embedding-service\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'embedding-service/.venv/bin/python'; const res = cp.spawnSync(cmd, ['-m', 'pytest', '-v', 'embedding-service'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status ?? 0);"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
